records.title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
records.reason: The primary abstract evaluates regularization during LoRA fine-tuning and retention after task transfer; its cost is training-step overhead, outside inference-only scope.

records.title: Low-Dimensional High-Leverage Subspace Optimization: Beyond Full-Parameter Coupled Training for Neural Network Quantization
records.reason: The abstract studies quantization-aware optimization on compact image-classification networks (ImageNet/CIFAR-100), not LLM inference.

records.title: A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues
records.reason: The paper is biomedical kinetic phenotyping of engineered muscle tissue with a CNN-Transformer; no LLM inference scope.

records.title: Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models
records.reason: The comparison is optimizer choice during Mamba-2 training and token efficiency of training, not inference serving.

records.title: An Inline Control Architecture for Language Models in Intelligent Transportation Systems
records.reason: The contribution is semantic prompt security/guardrails for V2X LLM services; real-time constraints are context, not an inference-efficiency method.
